My Dearest, For Vracillia 💌

I am writing this because words sometimes catch in my throat when I look at you, overwhelmed by how much you mean to me. Please keep this little note as a token of my heart—a small reminder of us.

You are my peace, my constant joy, and the brightest part of my life. No matter where we are or how long the days feel before I can hold you again, please never forget how deeply, truly, and completely you are loved.

Forever and always yours,

With all my love ❤️
